lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin, forming a structured grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs to form high-contrast anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow transition along their horizontal axes.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots is visible across the entire dorsal surface of the pectoral fin; one yellow-hued carangid fish is positioned immediately dorsal to the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
